titulo: Forgot why I came up: stop, say what for, one step down
caption:
Forgot why I came up: stop, say what for, one step down

I forgot why I came up. If I forget why I came, I stop and say what for: a slow in, a rest on the landing, one step down. Wrong room. For whoever stands in doorways like this.

Closer to yourself.

More behaviors: link in bio.
